newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF sale seen in summer- ministry source.
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF sale seen in summer- ministry source.

text.p: The privatisation of the government's 58 percent stake in defense electronics firm Thomson-CSF is expected to take place in the summer, a Finance Ministry source said on Thursday.
The opening on Wednesday of the sale procedure through a private placement "should lead to the privatisation of Thomson-CSF during the summer," the source said.
The source reiterated that the government "wishes for the largest possible grouping (around Thomson) to constitute a defence group on a global scale".
